aboutMeParagraphs.heading: About Me
areasOfInterest: Large Language Models in Software Development Lifecycle
aboutMeParagraphs.paragraph1: I am a Software Engineer with 4 years of industry experience building scalable full-stack systems, and my focus has increasingly shifted toward AI for Software Engineering (AI4SE). My work explores how large language models can make software development more reliable, secure and efficient, both in research on secure code generation and in industry through LLM-powered tools and agentic development workflows. I enjoy working where solid engineering practice meets applied AI research.

research1.title: Volunteer Researcher — Secure Software Engineering & AI-Generated Code
research1.description: Collaborated with Dr. Tanmay Bhowmik and his research group SERA (Software Engineering Research and Analysis Lab) at Kennesaw State University on security weaknesses in AI-generated code.
research1.orgnaization: SERA Lab (Software Engineering Research and Analysis Lab), Kennesaw State University
research1.technologies: Python, Bash, CodeQL, Bandit, GitHub API
bulletPoints: Led a research project with Dr. Tanmay Bhowmik’s SERA Lab as first author of a paper (under review) on secure code generation; identified the security–functionality trade-off in existing LLM-based methods and drove the work from problem formulation to evaluation.

Developed a two-stage generate-then-select framework that builds a diverse candidate pool via multiple generation strategies and security-aware retrieval, then selects the final solution through test free ranking based on test agreement, consensus, and security scores.

Outperformed four state-of-the-art baselines across 1,200+ tasks and multiple LLMs, with a 24–30% relative gain in secure-and-correct generation; used independent analyzers (CodeQL, Bandit) to prevent evaluation leakage.

Built a pipeline that mines AI-generated Python from GitHub, detects CWE weaknesses with CodeQL, and maps them to real-world CVEs with CVSS severity, providing the empirical motivation for the framework.

research2.title: Undergrad thesis: Speaker Diarization with Speech Recognition in Bengali
research2.description: Addressed the problem of multi-speaker transcription in Bangla by developing a system that combines speaker diarization ("who spoke when") and speech recognition ("what was said") to generate structured, dialogue-style transcripts.
research2.orgnaization: Shahjalal University of Science and Technology
research2.technologies: Python, Google Cloud Speech-to-Text, Tensorflow, ELAN, Audacity
research2.warning: You can contact me if you want to read the thesis.
bulletPoints: Designed a full pipeline using Bi-LSTM for speaker diarization and Google Cloud Speech-to-Text for transcription, incorporating voice activity detection, speaker segmentation, and clustering.
Integrated the WebRTC VAD library for detecting speech regions, developed custom code snippets to link VAD with segmentation, and used pyannote-audio embeddings for speaker representation.
Collected and annotated 8 hours of Bangla audio data from YouTube debates and talk shows using ELAN,Audacity, and y2Mate.

research4.title: Vocabuilder - AI-Powered Vocabulary Builder
research4.description: A modern web application for building vocabulary with AI-powered word analysis, intelligent learning features, and contextual story generation. Built with LLM technology, LangChain, and vector databases, this project combines advanced AI with modern web frameworks to create a powerful vocabulary learning experience.
research4.technologies: Python, FastAPI, RAG, LangChain, ChromaDB, OpenAI, Google Gemini, PostgreSQL, Next.js, TypeScript
research4.warning: The backend and database are hosted on two different servers in different regions in free tier, so the live demo will be slow and not responsive as the recorded demo.
bulletPoints: AI-Powered Learning Features: Multi-model AI analysis with OpenAI and Google Gemini.
Contextual Story Generation: Generates engaging stories using vocabulary words in context.
Semantic Similarity: Finds similar words using embeddings and semantic search.
Advanced AI Architecture: LangChain-based prompt engineering with vector database integration.
